accountLead.message: Your saved articles belong to $1. While you are logged in as $2, nothing is saved or marked missing.

addedButNotInCart.message: Cardmarket accepted it, but it is not in your cart.

badgeTitle.message: Cart Saver – $1 saved articles not in your cart

badgeTitleOne.message: Cart Saver – 1 saved article not in your cart

cartSavedLead.message: $1 articles in your cart are saved.

cartSavedLeadOne.message: 1 article in your cart is saved.

cartsEmptyLead.message: Save what is in your cart as a list (for example per deck) with “Save as list…” in the Cart tab. Put it back here later with one click.

cartsFull.message: You already have $1 saved lists. Delete one first.

cartsNothing.message: There is nothing in the list to save.

cartsUpdateHint.message: Replace the articles with what the Cart tab holds now

clearConfirm.message: Delete all saved articles, favourites and saved lists? This cannot be undone.

cleared.message: All saved articles, favourites and saved lists were deleted.

dataSummary.message: $1 saved: $2 in your cart, $3 partly, $4 missing, $5 unavailable. $6, $7.

dataTitle.message: Your saved articles, favourites and lists

emptyLead.message: Open your shopping cart on Cardmarket and Cart Saver remembers its articles automatically.

errorBusy.message: Already putting articles back — wait until that has finished.

errorCartUnreadable.message: Your cart page could not be read, so nothing was added (Cardmarket may have changed its layout). This extension probably needs an update.

errorChallenge.message: Cardmarket is showing a security check. Reload the page, complete the check and try again.

errorHttp.message: Cardmarket returned an unexpected error. Try again later.

errorLoggedOut.message: You are not logged in on Cardmarket. Log in and try again.

errorNetwork.message: No connection to Cardmarket. Check your internet connection.

errorNoEndpoint.message: Cardmarket changed how adding to the cart works. This extension needs an update.

errorNoToken.message: Cardmarket's security code (token) was not found on the page. Reload the page and try again.

errorOtherAccount.message: You are logged in with another Cardmarket account than the one these articles were saved with.

errorRateLimited.message: Cardmarket asked to slow down. Wait a few minutes and try again.

errorUnexpected.message: Cardmarket gave an unexpected answer, so nothing more was added. Try again; if it keeps happening, send the details below to the developer.

expiryLine.message: Cardmarket empties your cart at $1 (in $2 min).

extDescription.message: Remembers what you put in your Cardmarket shopping cart and puts it back with one click after the cart was emptied.

favEmptyLead.message: Click the ☆ next to an offer on Cardmarket (or an article in your cart) to keep it here.

favNotOnPageLead.message: This offer from $1 is not listed here. It may have been sold, or it is further down the list.

how1.message: Put articles in your Cardmarket cart as usual, from any game. Cart Saver remembers them by itself.

how2.message: When Cardmarket empties your cart, a reminder appears on the site and the icon counts along. Click “Put … back in your cart”, in the popup or in the panel on Cardmarket. Changed your mind? “Undo”.

how3.message: When something was sold meanwhile, it gets a stamp. “Find a replacement” looks for the same card at the same seller, at a seller already in your cart, or the cheapest similar offer.

how4.message: Save your cart as a list (for example per deck) with “Save as list…”, and put it back later with one click. What you buy leaves the list by itself.

how5.message: Click the ☆ next to any offer (or article in your cart) to keep it as a favourite. Find it again under Favourites in the popup.

importFailed.message: That file could not be read.

interruptedLead.message: The tab was closed or left before everything was back. $1 still to go.

jobCancelled.message: Stopped before all articles were put back.

listAllInCart.message: Everything on this list is already in your cart.

notifyEmptiedText.message: $1 saved articles are no longer in your cart. Click to put them back.

notifyEmptiedTextOne.message: 1 saved article is no longer in your cart. Click to put it back.

notifyExpiryText.message: In about $1 minutes. Click to open your cart.

notifyExpiryTextOne.message: In about 1 minute. Click to open your cart.

notifyExpiryTitle.message: Your Cardmarket cart is about to be emptied

panelNoItemsLead.message: Cart Saver remembers everything you put in your cart.

panelNoItemsLeadManual.message: Saving automatically is off: read your cart with the button below.

privacyNote.message: Everything is stored locally in your browser. Cart Saver only talks to Cardmarket (the site and its pictures), through your own session.

prunedNote.message: $1 sold articles left the list: not looked at for a month.

prunedNoteOne.message: 1 sold article left the list: not looked at for a month.

reasonSeller.message: Everything from this seller left your cart

reasonSingle.message: Only this article left your cart, probably sold

refillQueued.message: Opening your cart on Cardmarket — putting articles back starts automatically.

refillRunningLead.message: Putting articles back in your cart…

refillSummary.message: $1 put in your cart, $2 not added.

refusedSold.message: Sold or no longer for sale

refusedUnknown.message: Cardmarket did not accept it. It stays on your list, try again later.

reminderLead.message: $1 saved articles ($2) are no longer in your cart.

reminderLeadOne.message: 1 saved article ($2) is no longer in your cart.

removeInCartHint.message: Take it out of your cart on Cardmarket; Cart Saver then forgets it by itself.

replaceInCart.message: Seller already in your cart: no extra shipping

settingAutoTrackHelp.message: Every article that appears in your cart is remembered. When off, read your cart with the “Read the cart now” button in the panel on the cart page.

settingAway.message: Check the cart while you are away from Cardmarket

settingAwayHelp.message: With a Cardmarket tab open and you at the computer, the cart is read at most every 10 minutes, so you hear sooner when it was emptied. Off by default: it adds requests.

settingDelayHelp.message: Articles are put back one by one. A longer pause is friendlier to Cardmarket.

settingNotifyHelp.message: A notification when saved articles leave your cart while you are elsewhere, and 5 minutes before Cardmarket empties your cart (when the cart page shows that time).

settingReminderHelp.message: When saved articles fell out of your cart, a small panel offers to put them back.

settingTrendHelp.message: Once a day the public Cardmarket price guide is downloaded (a large file); only your saved articles are kept. Offers clearly above the trend get a note.

shippingMoreThanCards.message: shipping costs more than the articles

shippingNearTracked.message: $1 below the 25 € limit for tracked shipping

soldOnlyLead.message: They cannot go back. Find a replacement, or take them off the list.

summaryAllInForSale.message: Everything still for sale is in your cart

trendStatusError.message: Could not read the price guide: $1

undoDone.message: $1 articles taken out of your cart again.

undoDoneOne.message: 1 article taken out of your cart again.

undoQueued.message: Opening Cardmarket; undoing starts by itself.

undoRunning.message: Taking the added articles out of your cart again…

updatedPill.message: Cart Saver updated · reload the page
